feature: WebTransport HTTP/2 connection completion and retirement

behavior.generation_ids: reserve the next generation ID while admitting the connection attempt under the State mutex; returned connector results do not reacquire that mutex for ID allocation
behavior.owner_admission: EndpointClient.initWithDeadline transfers ownership on entry and checks caller deadline and cancellation before and after starting the connection owner; failed or late initialization closes the unpublished transport abortively
behavior.publication: candidate State publication uses the original caller deadline and checks cancellation even after an uncontended acquisition; failed publication closes the unpublished candidate and records a failed attempt
behavior.failed_attempt: one in-progress attempt publishes one allocation-free pending completion without waiting for the State mutex; the next CONNECT applies it once and schedules backoff from the recorded completion time
behavior.terminal_observation: EndpointClient.terminalFailure reads an atomic error code, without its metadata mutex
behavior.retirement: if State cannot be acquired immediately, mark the exact generation for retirement and return; old generation handles report StaleConnection; the next CONNECT removes it before establishing a new generation
behavior.abortive_shutdown: an atomic flag and wake request owner shutdown without acquiring endpoint metadata mutex; worker rechecks the flag after resetting its wake; owner cleanup releases session state and closes without further protocol output
behavior.structure: target/retry classification and owner initialization live in target.zig and init.zig; connection State remains the generation publication owner

python_interop_debug.scope: direct Session wire compatibility; the reconnecting facade and owner changes are exercised by the owning module TLS and socket-backed regressions

completion_cases: parent State mutex held during candidate publication until caller deadline
Canceled while candidate publication contends on State mutex
Canceled after an uncontended publication acquisition
connector OutOfMemory while State mutex is held
endpoint owner ConcurrencyUnavailable while State mutex is held
connector returns a transport after caller deadline
owner starts before deadline but caller clock advances past it before construction returns
verification.case_invariants: no published candidate or retained activity, no uncancellable State acquisition, transferred provisional TCP connection reaches peer EOF, pending failed attempt is preserved and later consumed, next generation publishes successfully
verification.retirement_invariants: hold endpoint metadata mutex and reconnecting State mutex, observe terminal state and request retirement/shutdown without uncancellable acquisition, reject old generation ID, then establish replacement generation after old TCP connection reaches peer EOF
verification.existing_tls: future-Session-only reconnect, retained rejection, generation isolation and HTTP CONNECT/SOCKS5 proxy cases remain in the WebTransport HTTP2 gate

limitations: custom connector callbacks must cooperate with the deadline; a callback returning late is rejected and its transport reclaimed, but the facade cannot preempt arbitrary callback code
final owner destruction still joins its task; the evidence covers the recorded creation/publication/retirement boundaries and does not claim arbitrary user-held internal locks can be preempted
broader protocol integration and multi-hour/high-concurrency evidence remain open for the full library goal
